blurb: Named as one of the Best Clubs in America by Rolling Stone magazine, the Bluebird's 500-person capacity offers an intimate event venue with a vintage, historic vibe. Built in 1913, the classic Bluebird Theater was originally a vaudeville theater, turned movie theater in the 1960’s.
